claims_boundary: These findings constrain Worldshepherd novelty claims; they do not promote capability maturity.
Existing DOE autonomous-science infrastructure must be treated as prior art and integration context.
No proposal authorizes submission, outreach, physical execution, or partner claims.

proposals.statement: The American Science Cloud already provides a federated environment connecting scientific data, workflows, computing resources, and AI/ML services; its Model Access Gateway already supports agentic workflows, data discovery, and model evaluations.
falsification_tests: Reject any Worldshepherd novelty statement that depends only on providing AI model access, generic agentic workflows, data discovery, or model evaluation unless a measurable non-duplicative function is demonstrated.

proposals.statement: Argonne's Rapid Prototyping Laboratory integrates diverse instruments into the MADSci software ecosystem, and MADSci with Globus manages end-to-end autonomous scientific workflows including data collection, reduction, machine-learning training, experiment steering, coupled simulation, storage, and publication.
falsification_tests: Compare Worldshepherd against MADSci/Globus-class orchestration on the same workflow and retain only capabilities that are independently measurable and not already supplied by the orchestration stack.

proposals.statement: ORNL reports operating more than a dozen self-driving laboratories and has demonstrated autonomous materials experiments, including AI-driven pulsed-laser-deposition workflows with reported 10-100x faster exploration and synthesis in that research context.
falsification_tests: Do not claim autonomous experimentation itself as Worldshepherd novelty; benchmark assurance functions against a realistic self-driving-lab workflow and quantify added latency versus error-rejection benefit.

proposals.statement: A generic claim that Worldshepherd is novel because it orchestrates AI-driven laboratory workflows is contradicted by existing DOE infrastructure including AmSC/MAG and MADSci/Globus. The defensible candidate differentiation is independent assurance: falsification, claims gating, evidence custody, deterministic replay, and cross-system auditability.
falsification_tests: Attempt to map each proposed Worldshepherd pitch feature to an existing DOE capability; remove or narrow every feature with no measurable differentiation before external submission.
